thought.text: CLI lengkap. Sekarang tes yang sebenarnya: deploy service nyata. Saya siapkan app kecil dulu.

action.command:
mkdir -p /workspace/project/apps/inktest && cd /workspace/project/apps/inktest && cat > app.py <<'EOF'
import http.server, json, os
class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(s):
        b=json.dumps({"ok":True,"msg":"halo dari INK","ts":os.environ.get("TZ","")}).encode()
        s.send_response(200); s.send_header("Content-Type","application/json")
        s.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(b))); s.end_headers(); s.wfile.write(b)
    def log_message(s,*a): pass
http.server.HTTPServer(("0.0.0.0",int(os.environ.get("PORT","8080"))),H).serve_forever()
EOF
cat > package.json <<'EOF'
{"name":"inktest","version":"1.0.0","scripts":{"start":"python3 app.py"}}
EOF
cat > Dockerfile <<'EOF'
FROM python:3.12-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY app.py .
ENV PORT=8080
CMD ["python3","app.py"]
EOF
git init -q 2>/dev/null; git add -A; git -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@t commit -qm init; ls; echo "---"; export PATH="$HOME/.npm-global/bin:$PATH"; ink deploy --help 2>&1 | head -30
